mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a custom outdoor cooking area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a custom outdoor cooking area can vary significantly, ranging from a few thousand dollars for a basic setup to tens of thousands for a fully equipped luxury kitchen. Factors influencing the price include the size of the area, chosen materials, types and brands of appliances, and the complexity of utility installations (gas lines, plumbing, electrical). During your initial consultation, clearly outlining your desired features and budget will help us provide a more accurate estimate tailored to your specific project needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a custom outdoor cooking area vary widely based on size, materials, appliances, and utility complexity. Discussing your budget early helps us provide an accurate estimate.
